## M1 — Citizen accounts + grievances + role login (backend) · **start now, done by 2 Oct 12:00**
1. Schema (`packages/db/src/schema/citizen.ts`, then `pnpm db:generate` → `0005_*`):
   - `citizen_accounts`: id, phone_enc bytea (AES-GCM like `persons.phone_enc`), phone_masked, phone_hash (sha256 for
     lookup, unique), password_hash (argon2id), phone_verified_at, person_id null fk, link_status
     (`unlinked|pending_officer|linked|rejected`), link_requested_village_code, link_requested_survey_no,
     linked_by_post_id, failed_logins, locked_until, data_source, created_at.
   - `grievances`: id, tracking_no unique (`GRV-2026-000123`, sequence), citizen_account_id null (anonymous allowed
     with phone OTP), project_id null, parcel_id null, village_code, category (`COMPENSATION|RNR|SURVEY_ERROR|
     NOTICE_NOT_RECEIVED|PAYMENT_NOT_RECEIVED|OTHER`), subject, body, language, status (`FILED|ASSIGNED|IN_PROGRESS|
     RESPONDED|CLOSED|REOPENED`), assigned_post_id, sla_due_at, responded_at, closed_at, resolution, data_source.
   - `grievance_events` (append-only via the existing `trg_append_only` pattern): grievance_id, event, note,
     actor_post_id null, actor_citizen_id null, at.
2. `packages/db/sql/07_citizen_grievance.sql`: RLS on `grievances` + `grievance_events` — officers see rows where
   `project_id` is in scope (`project_in_scope`) or `can_see_village(village_code)`; `citizen_accounts` not readable
   by `app_user` except through definer functions; definer functions `citizen_my_grievances(citizen_id)`,
   `citizen_my_parcels(citizen_id)` (only via linked person's `parcel_interests`, returns survey no., village,
   project, parcel status, stage, last public notice — no other persons' data), granted to `app_user`. Update
   `packages/db/test` with RLS tests for the new tables (Pune post cannot see a Nagpur grievance; citizen A cannot read
   citizen B).
3. Citizen auth (module `apps/api/src/citizen`): separate JWT audience `citizen` (cookie `bs_citizen`), never mixed
   with officer posts. Endpoints: `POST /citizen/signup {phone, password, name}` → OTP sent via `SmsAdapter` (mock,
   visible at `/dev/sms`); `POST /citizen/otp/verify`; `POST /citizen/login`; `POST /citizen/logout`;
   `GET /citizen/me`; `POST /citizen/link-request {villageCode, surveyNumber}` → `pending_officer`; officer
   `GET /citizen-links?status=pending`, `POST /citizen-links/:id/decide {approve, personId}` (DISTRICT staff/LAO).
   Throttle 5/min/IP on auth routes; lockout after 5 failures (same as officers); audit every mutation.
4. Grievances (module `apps/api/src/grievance`): `POST /grievances` (citizen session, or anonymous with phone OTP) →
   tracking number; routing: `assigned_post_id` = LAO post of the parcel's/village's district, else the district
   Collector post; `sla_due_at` from a single **administrative** constant in `packages/shared/src/grievance.ts`
   (`GRIEVANCE_SLA_DAYS`, comment: "administrative target, not statutory") computed with `ClockService`;
   `GET /public/grievances/:trackingNo` (status, timeline, no PII); officer `GET /grievances?status=&projectId=`,
   `POST /grievances/:id/assign|respond|close|reopen`; outbox event `GRIEVANCE_FILED` → notification to the assigned
   post (in-app + email via MailHog). Every mutation writes `audit_log`.
5. Role-first officer login: `GET /auth/roles` (public; role codes + English/Hindi/Marathi labels from
   `packages/shared/src/enums.ts`), and `POST /auth/login` accepts `role` (in addition to existing `postId`): pick the
   user's active post with that role; reject with 403 `NO_POST_FOR_ROLE` otherwise. Existing `postId` validation
   stays. Add auth e2e tests (right role → 200, wrong role → 403).
6. API e2e tests for citizen signup/OTP/login/link, grievance file → assign → respond → close, public tracking.
**Done when**: `pnpm test:e2e:api` and `pnpm test:db` green with the new tests; `pnpm db:reset` seeds ~20 synthetic
citizen accounts (some linked, some pending) and ~30 grievances across districts (deterministic, `SYNTHETIC_DEMO`).

## M4 — AI layer UI · 3 Oct, by 12:00 (hand `AskDrawer` to Chaitanya at 12:00)
1. `components/ai/AskDrawer.tsx`: UX4G Drawer (right). Header "Ask BhoomiSetu" + scope chip (active post jurisdiction)
   + **"Mock mode"** Badge when the API reports `LLM_PROVIDER=mock`. Suggested question chips (one per whitelisted
   tool): "Which deadlines breach in the next 30 days?", "Show the disbursed vs acknowledged gap",
   "Where are projects getting stuck?", "Rank districts by possession", "Summarise MH-PSX-2026-001",
   "Explain the s.19 deadline on MH-PSX", "National KPIs". Input + Send → `POST /assistant/query`; answer Card shows
   text + expandable **"Sources: tool calls"** (tool name, arguments, returned numbers). No confidence figure. Footer:
   "Advisory only — answers use your own data scope; AI cannot change any record."
2. `components/ai/AiSuggestion.tsx`: shows `ai_suggested_*` values as a tonal Tag "AI suggestion" + reason/confidence
   only if the API supplies one + buttons **Accept** (calls the confirm endpoint) and **Change**. Never auto-applies (G3).
3. `components/ai/RiskExplain.tsx`: score/100 + band Tag + top factors (name, points, evidence) labelled
   "Risk score (advisory) — heuristic". Give it to Atulit (parcel 360°) and Chaitanya (workspace) via the shared path.
4. Objection triage page `/project/[id]/objections`: Table of objections (`GET /projects/:id/objections`) with channel,
   language, status, AI suggestion; row Drawer: body/transcript, `AiSuggestion` for statutory ground + operational
   category (Accept → `POST /objections/:id/classify`), run triage (`POST /objections/:id/triage`), schedule hearing
   (`/schedule`), decide (`/decide`) with remarks.
